# Online Presence Audit — John Adams, Adams, Cameron & Co. (Daytona Beach, FL)

## 1. Online Presence Dashboard

**Overall Score: 58 / 100** 🟡

| Category | Score | Status |
|---|---|---|
| A. Social Media | 45/100 | 🔴 |
| B. Review Platforms | 40/100 | 🔴 |
| C. Real Estate Platform Profiles | 65/100 | 🟡 |
| D. Local SEO / Geographic Visibility | 70/100 | 🟡 |
| E. AI Search Visibility | 35/100 | 🔴 |
| F. Brand Consistency | 60/100 | 🟡 |
| G. Compliance & Risk | 55/100 | 🟡 |

**Key takeaway:** John Adams benefits enormously from the strength of the Adams, Cameron & Co. brand — the brokerage he serves as President — but almost none of his individual online presence is *personalized to him*. His digital footprint is largely subsumed into the corporate brand, and where individual profiles exist, they are thin, contain contradictory data, and lack agent-specific reviews. This is a significant liability for someone whose name is on the door.

---

## 2. Detailed Findings

### A. Social Media 🔴 (45/100)

- **LinkedIn — Present, but thin.** A personal profile exists under John J. Adams. 
His profile lists President of Adams, Cameron & Co. Realtors, education at Kellogg School of Business, location Ormond Beach, and 500+ connections.
 See [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/johnjadams/). The [company LinkedIn page](https://www.linkedin.com/company/adams-cameron-&-co.-realtors) shows 
999 followers, describing the firm as Volusia County's undisputed real estate leader with total sales far exceeding any other company in the Daytona Beach area.
 Individual profile shows minimal recent posting activity or original content visible.

- **Facebook — Personal broker page present but very low engagement.** A dedicated page exists: [John J Adams, Real Estate Broker](https://www.facebook.com/brokerjohnadams/), which is 
titled "John J Adams, Real Estate Broker," based in Daytona Beach, Florida, with 305 likes, focused on Volusia and Flagler Counties.
 305 likes is very low for a brokerage president. The corporate [Adams, Cameron & Co. Facebook page](https://www.facebook.com/adamscameron/) is far stronger with 
4,156 likes, 7 talking about this, and 420 check-ins.


- **Instagram — No verifiable agent profile found.** A search surfaced an unrelated "John Adams" ([@johnadamsfox5](https://www.instagram.com/johnadamsfox5/)) who is 
an Atlanta-based real estate broker and investor with 355 followers, 133 following, and 11 posts
 — this is **not** the Daytona Beach agent. **No confirmed Instagram profile found** for John Adams of Adams, Cameron & Co.

- **YouTube — No profile found.** No dedicated YouTube channel for John Adams was located in search.

- **TikTok — No profile found.** No dedicated TikTok account for John Adams (Daytona Beach realtor) was located.

- **X/Twitter — No profile found.** No verifiable X/Twitter account for John Adams (Daytona Beach realtor) was located.

**Assessment:** Only LinkedIn and a low-follower Facebook page are attributable to him. There is no consistent visual/brand identity across platforms, no evidence of recent video content, and engagement is minimal.

### B. Review Platforms 🔴 (40/100)

The critical finding here: **reviews accrue to the brokerage, not to John Adams as an individual agent.**

- **Zillow — Brokerage profile only.** The [Zillow profile](https://www.zillow.com/profile/AdamsCameronandCo) is for Adams, Cameron & Co. as a whole, not John Adams individually. Reviews visible reference *other* agents — 
e.g., "Debra Morfis is amazing! She is extremely engaged and helpful. She has a ton of local contacts... Her knowledge of the area is extensive. I have worked with her on several properties..."
 — and Stan/Diana Janzen, Fred Jones, etc. **No agent-specific rating for John Adams was found on Zillow.**

- **Realtor.com — No individual agent profile found.** No dedicated Realtor.com profile page for John Adams was surfaced.

- **Google Business Profile — Not individually verifiable.** No standalone Google Business Profile for "John Adams, realtor" was located; reviews appear to route to the brokerage's office listings.

- **Yelp — Listing exists but appears empty of agent reviews.** A [Yelp page for JOHN ADAMS](https://www.yelp.com/biz/john-adams-daytona-beach) exists at the 600 S Atlantic Ave address with phone (386) 253-8044, and Yelp notes 
people searched for Real Estate Agents 390 times last month within 15 miles of this business.
 No visible star rating or review body for John Adams himself.

- **Facebook reviews** default to the corporate page rather than his personal broker page.

- **Brokerage-level review strength (context, not attributable to John Adams):** Adams, Cameron & Co. rates strongly — 
4.91★ from 233 verified reviews on Experience.com
 ([Experience.com](https://www.experience.com/reviews/adams-12600423)) and 
a 4.9 star rating with 458 reviews on Birdeye
 ([Birdeye](https://reviews.birdeye.com/adams-cameron-co-realtors-165103656329844)). However, essentially all named reviews cite other agents (Jeff & Toni Wright, Les Puc, Kristy, Debra Morfis, Dulce Monahan, etc.), **not John Adams.**

- **BBB:** The firm is 
rated A+ and is 63 years in business, with the BBB file opened 10/1/2004
 ([BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/fl/daytona-beach/profile/real-estate/adams-cameron-co-realtors-0733-13003413)), though 
it is NOT BBB Accredited.


**Assessment:** As an individual, John Adams has virtually **no personal review corpus** despite being the company President. This is a major gap — a prospective client searching his name finds no direct social proof.

### C. Real Estate Platform Profiles 🟡 (65/100)

- **Homes.com — Complete and detailed.** The [Homes.com profile](https://www.homes.com/real-estate-agents/john-adams/7z21lqz/) is robust, including a full bio: 
John Adams serves as the President of Adams, Cameron & Co., is a native of the Daytona Beach area, attended Seabreeze and Father Lopez High Schools, and went to Florida State University majoring in Business Management with an emphasis in Information Systems.
 It lists service specialties: 
Distressed Properties, First Time Home Buyers, Foreclosures, Investments, Luxury Homes, Military Families, New Construction, Property Management, Senior Communities, Short Sales, Timeshares, and Veteran Programs.


- **Personal brokerage microsite — Present.** He has a dedicated site: [johnadams.adamscameron.com](https://johnadams.adamscameron.com/) with a personalized bio and blog content, listing 
designations MBA, GRI, ABR, C2EX and Ponce Inlet office.


- **LoopNet (commercial) — Present.** [LoopNet profile](https://www.loopnet.com/commercial-real-estate-brokers/profile/john-adams/68tgkctb) confirms 
he holds a Florida Broker's License and is actively involved in many industry organizations.


- **Zillow — No individual agent profile** (only brokerage; see Section B).

- **Realtor.com — No individual profile found.**

- **Redfin — No individual profile found for John Adams.** (Other Adams, Cameron agents appear on Redfin, e.g., [Jeffrey Wright](https://www.redfin.com/real-estate-agents/jeffrey-wright), but not John Adams.)

**Assessment:** Good depth on Homes.com and his own microsite, but glaring absence on the two most consumer-trafficked platforms (Zillow individual profile, Realtor.com, Redfin). Active listing visibility tied to him personally is not evident — listings appear under the brokerage or specific selling agents.

### D. Local SEO / Geographic Visibility 🟡 (70/100)

Testing the three client-style searches:

- **"real estate agent Daytona Beach, FL" / "Daytona Beach, FL realtor":** The Adams, Cameron & Co. brand dominates directory results. The firm appears across [Yelp's best-of list](https://www.yelp.com/search?cflt=realestateagents&find_loc=Daytona+Beach%2C+FL), [EffectiveAgents](https://www.effectiveagents.com/fl/daytona-beach), [FastExpert](https://www.fastexpert.com/top-real-estate-agents/daytona-beach-fl/), [U.S. News](https://realestate.usnews.com/agents/florida/daytona-beach), and [Expertise.com](https://www.expertise.com/home-improvement/real-estate-agents/florida/daytona-beach). EffectiveAgents ranks the firm strongly — 
Adams Cameron and Co, 13 years of experience, 132+ sales in the last 12 months, Top 0.28% in Daytona Beach, FL, with $332.2M all-time sales.


- **Important nuance:** In these directory results, the *named* agents who surface tend to be other Adams Cameron agents (e.g., 
Tanreka Smith and Riley Hill of Adams Cameron & Co. Realtors appear among Yelp's best real estate agents in Daytona Beach
), **not John Adams**. John rides on brand equity, not personal SEO.

- **Maps/Local Pack:** The brokerage's offices (600 S. Atlantic Ave; 3118 S Atlantic Ave; 1100 Dunlawton Ave) anchor Maps presence, but John Adams as an individual does not command his own Maps pin.

**Assessment:** Strong *brand-level* geographic visibility; weak *personal* organic visibility. A client searching for the agent by category will find the company, then be routed to other agents.

### E. AI Search Visibility 🔴 (35/100)

Testing "best real estate agent in Daytona Beach, FL" and "top realtor Daytona Beach, FL" against the sources AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) typically synthesize:

- AI answers draw heavily from directory/aggregator pages (HomeLight, FastExpert, U.S. News, Expertise, Yelp, EffectiveAgents). In these, **Adams, Cameron & Co. is consistently surfaced as a brokerage**, and Expertise.com highlights that 
Adams Cameron & Co. Realtors has been providing real estate services to clients in Daytona Beach since 1963.

- However, **John Adams the individual is rarely, if ever, named** by these aggregators as a "top agent" — those slots go to high-transaction-volume selling agents (Alice Cooper, Jeff/Toni Wright, Tanreka Smith, etc.). Because AI engines rank by review count and transaction data attached to individuals, John's lack of a personal review corpus means he is unlikely to be surfaced by name.

**Assessment:** AI models will name the *brokerage he leads* but will not recommend *him* as a "best agent." For a company President this is a strategic weakness — his personal authority is invisible to AI-driven search.

### F. Brand Consistency 🟡 (60/100)

- **Aligned elements:** His microsite, Homes.com, and LoopNet bios consistently reference the Adams, Cameron & Co. brand, the 1963 founding, and "largest real estate company in Volusia/Flagler." 
The firm is described as the largest real estate company in the combined Volusia and Flagler Counties with more agents, marketing, technology, and more sales than any other local company
 — messaging that recurs across his profiles.

- **Inconsistencies (brand risk):**
  1. **Title conflict.** He is described as **President** on Homes.com and LoopNet (
serves as the President of Adams, Cameron & Co.
), but on [findingtheuncommondeal.com](https://findingtheuncommondeal.com/experts-john-j-adams/) he is listed as 
General Manager for Adams, Cameron & Co.
 Mixed titles across the web dilute brand clarity (though this older source may simply be outdated).
  2. **Office location conflict.** His microsite repeatedly places him in the **Ponce Inlet office** (
serving the East Central Florida region from our Ponce Inlet office
), while other Adams Cameron pages list him under the **Daytona Beach office**. Internal/brand address inconsistency.
  3. **Phone number sprawl.** Multiple different numbers are attached to him: 
Primary: (386) 253-8044
 on the agent list, 
(386) 299-9504
 on his microsite contact block, and 
386-717-3445
 on a partner site. Inconsistent NAP (Name-Address-Phone) data harms both brand trust and local SEO.

### G. Compliance & Risk 🟡 (55/100)

- **License status — Unable to fully verify individual record.** Multiple sources indicate he is licensed: LoopNet states 
he holds a Florida Broker's License
. However, a direct FL DBPR ([MyFloridaLicense](https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/real-estate-commission/public-records/)) record for **John Adams specifically was not retrieved** — the DBPR result surfaced was for an unrelated licensee (ADAMS, ROBERTA J). **His exact license number and current status could not be independently confirmed via DBPR in this audit** — this should be verified directly. Note his displayed designations are 
MBA, GRI, ABR, C2EX.


- **License number accuracy — Not displayed on consumer-facing profiles.** Neither his microsite nor Homes.com prominently displays his FL license number. By contrast, other Adams Cameron agents do display theirs (e.g., 
Jeffrey Wright, Agent License #: SL3269390, Adams, Cameron & Co. Realtors
 on Redfin, and 
Dan Lyonnais with License Number BK3520302
). **Missing license number display is a compliance gap.**

- **Post-2024 NAR settlement buyer-rep/compensation disclosures — Not evident.** No buyer-representation-agreement or compensation-disclosure language was found on his personal microsite. This is an area to review against current NAR/Florida requirements.

- **Equal Housing Opportunity logo — Not verified on his personal pages.** No EHO logo was confirmed on his individual microsite in the retrieved content. Should be added if absent.

- **Personal information exposure:** His bio broadly publishes family details — 
references his wife Rene and son
 and 
names his social clubs (Oceanside Country Club, Halifax River Yacht Club, Sunset Harbor Yacht Club) and that he resides in Ormond Beach.
 While common for realtors, the combination of home city + clubs + family is a mild privacy/safety consideration.

### H. Red Flags & Concerns

| # | Red Flag | Detail | Urgency |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **No individual review corpus** | Despite being company President, no agent-specific reviews/ratings found on Zillow, Google, Realtor.com, or Yelp; all reviews route to the brokerage or other agents. | 🔴 High |
| 2 | **License number not displayed / not DBPR-verified in audit** | No FL license number on consumer profiles; direct DBPR record for John Adams not confirmed. Verify immediately. | 🔴 High |
| 3 | **Inconsistent NAP data** | Three different phone numbers ((386) 253-8044, (386) 299-9504, (386) 717-3445) and conflicting office locations (Daytona Beach vs. Ponce Inlet). | 🟡 Medium |
| 4 | **Conflicting job title** | Listed as both "President" and "General Manager" across sources. | 🟡 Medium |
| 5 | **Missing/unverified EHO logo & NAR-settlement disclosures** | No Equal Housing logo or buyer-rep/compensation disclosure confirmed on personal microsite. | 🟡 Medium |
| 6 | **Near-invisible in AI & organic personal search** | AI engines and directories surface the brokerage and other agents, not John Adams by name. | 🟡 Medium |
| 7 | **Outdated bio elements** | Bio references past roles ("happy to be back in Ormond Beach") and a family real-estate legacy tied to prior leadership; some third-party pages appear years old, risking stale info. Note his father Bob Adams died in 2022 and John has taken a larger leadership role. | 🟢 Low |

*(Note: A search also surfaced an unrelated Atlanta broker "John Adams" @johnadamsfox5 — a potential identity-confusion risk in search results, though not John's own content.)*

---

## 3. Top 5 Priority Actions (Ranked by Impact)

1. **Verify and publish FL license details immediately (Compliance).** Confirm John Adams's exact FL broker license number and active status directly at [MyFloridaLicense.com](https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/real-estate-commission/public-records/), then display the license number, Equal Housing Opportunity logo, and NAR-settlement-compliant buyer-representation/compensation disclosures on his [personal microsite](https://johnadams.adamscameron.com/) and all agent profiles. *Highest legal/reputational risk.*

2. **Build a dedicated, review-collecting individual presence on Zillow and Realtor.com.** Currently reviews only accrue to the [brokerage Zillow profile](https://www.zillow.com/profile/AdamsCameronandCo). Create/claim standalone Zillow and Realtor.com agent profiles for John Adams and systematically request reviews from past clients to build personal social proof — the single biggest driver of both consumer trust and AI-search recommendation.

3. **Standardize NAP and title across every profile.** Lock in one primary phone number, one office location, and one title ("President"), then correct it everywhere: [agent list](https://www.adamscameron.com/Homes/Agents/List.html), [microsite](https://johnadams.adamscameron.com/), [Homes.com](https://www.homes.com/real-estate-agents/john-adams/7z21lqz/), [LoopNet](https://www.loopnet.com/commercial-real-estate-brokers/profile/john-adams/68tgkctb), and outdated third-party pages. Consistent NAP directly improves local SEO and brand trust.

4. **Establish and brand personal social channels.** Grow the underperforming [Facebook broker page](https://www.facebook.com/brokerjohnadams/) (305 likes) and create consistent, verified Instagram and a YouTube/short-form video presence with matching branding, headshot, and bio. Post recent market/community content regularly to demonstrate recency and authority — leveraging his genuine community leadership roles.

5. **Improve AI & directory visibility by name.** Ensure John Adams is individually listed and optimized on the aggregators that feed AI engines (FastExpert, U.S. News, HomeLight, EffectiveAgents, Expertise.com), with transaction data and reviews attached to his name — not just the firm — so ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews can surface him personally for "best/top realtor Daytona Beach" queries.

---

*Audit limitations: Several findings ("no profile found," "unable to verify license number") reflect the absence of a retrievable public record at audit time and should be confirmed by the agent directly. Review counts and ratings cited are for Adams, Cameron & Co. at the brokerage level unless otherwise noted; no verified individual review metrics for John Adams were located.*
